**Grid Indexing:** Determine the integer grid indices for the corner cells surrounding $\mathbf{x}'$.
This yields 8 corner indices $(i_0, i_1, i_2)$ for the voxel containing $\mathbf{x}'$.
**Interpolation Weights:** Compute the fractional part of the normalized coordinate to determine interpolation weights.
The weights for the lower and upper corners are $1-w_j$ and $w_j$ respectively.
**Feature Lookup:** Retrieve the $k$-dimensional feature vectors $\mathbf{v}_{c}$ for each of the 8 corner cells $c \in \{0, \dots, 7\}$ from the grid.
where $\alpha_c$ is the product of the appropriate lower/upper weights for each dimension corresponding to corner $c$.
*   **Feature Dimension ($k$):** Size of the feature vector per cell.
*   **Empty Space Waste:** The method allocates features to empty space equally to surface areas.
*   **Time Complexity:** Lookup and interpolation are $O(1)$ with respect to grid size, depending only on the number of corners (8 for 3D trilinear) and feature dimension $k$.
